findings.finding: Wider S05 scan would also read generated playwright-report/ and test-results/ output, which may contain https links, failing every complete run.
findings.suggestion: Exclude generated output folders and add a unit case.

findings.finding: run.lock records only the spec process; if the spec is hard-killed, the WebUI server and agent keep running while the stale lock lets a resume start a second run on the same project.
findings.suggestion: Record the server pid in run.lock too.

findings.finding: markPipelineStarted runs after the report.step screenshot; a stop in between makes a resume click New pipeline again.
alive() uses only the pid; a reused pid yields a misleading 'stop it first' message.
findings.suggestion: Name run.lock as the thing to delete.

findings.finding: FILE_EXT lacks asset extensions such as svg, so fetch("icons.svg") reads as a host.
findings.suggestion: Add asset extensions and a unit case.

code.disposition: All 5 findings fixed in the same diff: report folders excluded, server pid in run.lock, started flag before screenshot, stale-lock hint, asset extensions; unit tests added
